programme: TRERF1, ZNF461, NR0B2 and NR2C2 sit on the same small set of steroidogenic nuclear-receptor control nodes rather than being a diffuse regulator list. TRERF1 (TReP-132) is a documented coactivator at CYP11A1 and CYP17A1, the enzymes that carry out the first and rate-limiting steps of steroid hormone synthesis. ZNF461 has only two targets in this record, SF1 (NR5A1) and NR5A2, the master nuclear receptors that specify steroidogenic and enterohepatic transcriptional programmes. NR0B2 (SHP) is the canonical corepressor that shuts this same SF1/NR5A2 axis down. NR2C2 (TR4) is a related orphan nuclear receptor whose target set also includes a steroidogenic enzyme (CYP21A2) alongside broader lipid/nuclear-receptor genes. Read together this is a coactivator/corepressor pair (TRERF1 vs NR0B2) acting on the same SF1/NR5A2 nodes, with NR2C2 as an affiliated orphan receptor in the same family.
role_in_a: In fibromyalgia this axis maps onto the HPA-axis/adrenal steroidogenesis dysregulation repeatedly described in the disease (blunted or altered cortisol output): transcriptional control of the SF1-driven programme at CYP11A1/CYP17A1 and at SF1/NR5A2 themselves is the kind of node this dysfunction would run through.
role_in_b: In rectal cancer, NR5A2 (LRH-1) is a validated colorectal-cancer-associated nuclear receptor controlling intestinal stem-cell proliferation and bile-acid/Wnt signalling, and NR0B2 (SHP) is its physiological repressor within the same bile-acid-sensing circuit; NR0B2 (percentile 0.802) and NR2C2 (percentile 0.5405) are independently placed among rectal-cancer-associated genes by Open Targets.
shared_axis: Both diseases have separately been linked to dysregulation of this SF1/NR5A2 nuclear-receptor circuit — HPA-axis/adrenal steroid output in fibromyalgia, LRH-1/bile-acid-driven intestinal proliferation in rectal cancer — so a coactivator/corepressor module recurring on the same nodes in both networks is consistent with each disease's separately described biology, even without a single source tying the two together directly.
reasoning: The four factors converge on a small, mechanistically specific node set (SF1, NR5A2, CYP11A1/17A1/21A2) rather than a generic nuclear-receptor list, and NR0B2/NR2C2 are independently placed in rectal cancer by Open Targets, so the module is nameable and partly placed. But no retrieved paper connects any of the four factors to fibromyalgia, so the fibromyalgia side of the account rests on established HPA-axis biology outside this record rather than on anything retrieved here — hence supported rather than established, and moderate rather than strong.
support: PMID 40881169 — retrieved for NR2C2 and discusses rectal adenocarcinoma, but the visible excerpt shows no explicit mechanistic link to NR2C2, so it is co-retrieved context rather than confirmatory evidence. No paper was retrieved for TRERF1, ZNF461, or NR0B2 in either disease.
how_to_falsify: Test whether TRERF1 and ZNF461 actually occupy the CYP11A1/CYP17A1 and SF1/NR5A2 loci in fibromyalgia-relevant tissue (e.g. PBMCs or adrenal cells) with ChIP or reporter assays paired with the same assay in colorectal epithelium; if binding/activation is absent in either tissue, or if NR0B2 knockdown fails to derepress NR5A2/SF1 target transcription in colon epithelial cells, the shared-axis claim fails. A correlation study between fibromyalgia symptom severity and CYP11A1/CYP17A1 or cortisol output would further test the disease-A role directly.
caveats: Blood (fibromyalgia) and colorectal tissue (rectal cancer) are a real anatomical distance from the canonically adrenal/gonadal/intestinal steroidogenic axis these targets belong to, so the fibromyalgia side requires assuming systemic or immune-cell expression of this circuit, which the record does not show. Support for the four carrying factors across patient-group comparisons is recurrent but not unanimous (47/80, 37/80, 39/80, 35/80 respectively), and Open Targets records no fibromyalgia association at all for any of the 12 listed factors. EOMES is the one factor in this list with real, specific colorectal-cancer support in the record (T-cell exhaustion/cytotoxicity, PMIDs 35322421 and 34975867) but it belongs to a mechanistically distinct immune programme and was deliberately left out of carrying_factors rather than folded in. ZBTB17 and KMT2E form a plausible cell-cycle checkpoint pair but that is generic cancer biology with no clear route into fibromyalgia; PAX4, ZMYND8, PHB1, HIF3A and NAB2 did not fit any coherent cross-disease story here. IRX5, TOX, SP8, KLF9, IRX2, FOXK2, SALL2, NFIL3, HOXA1, ZNF304, TFAP2E and MIXL1 are single-group factors excluded from this account, and EZH2/IRF8/STAT5B/KLF9/STAT3/PRDM1/FOS/RELB/ETS1/E2F2/ID2/STAT1 are tissue-generic and correctly absent rather than overlooked.
